title: A release moves dev, then staging, then prod-us, each through its release gate (Forgejo only)

steps.label: main lists promotion dev, staging, prod-us, prod-eu, every gate always, and plywood init writes one component for shop
release shop-p1 is cut from main's tip, tagged green
dev runs release shop-p1, its gate approved by the reviewer
plywood promote carries shop-p1 from dev to staging through its release gate
plywood promote carries shop-p1 from ${PLYWOOD_E2E_FROM:-staging} to prod-us through its release gate

break.note: the prod-us promote comes straight from dev, skipping staging, so chant refuses it before any gate, nothing is deployed to prod-us, and the applied step must fail. This runs on Forgejo only: the bench has no GitHub or GitLab, and those forges' status paths are not exercised.
